description: The campaign 'brain': decision-oriented rollups distilled from ab-database.json. ab-database.json holds raw per-post facts (one row per post); learnings.json is the aggregated view the posting loop uses to decide what to render/post next. Append-only decisions_log; rollups are recomputed from ab-database.json on each metrics pull.

brand_voice.what: SFFS brand-voice database: distilled voice principles + hard rules + a large, categorized corpus of REAL copy mined from the website and video pipeline. The auto-replier and the caption / variant generators MUST read this before writing any copy.
brand_voice.hard_rules: concise; funny; Gen Z lowercase-casual; kid-safe (no HARD/explicit profanity, but mild slang like 'af' is on-brand and allowed); NO em dashes; at most ONE tasteful emoji (never spam); no AI-slop tone; no over-explaining/lecturing; always end social copy with a follow / come-back nudge.
brand_voice.signature_device: SMART FELLA vs FART SMELLA binary: praise = Smart Fella, miss = Fart Smella '(for now)'.

how_the_loop_uses_this.read: Before generating/scheduling the next batch: read front_runners + rollups to bias toward the best-performing variant_family, hashtag_set, platform, and time_bucket; read decisions_log to avoid re-litigating settled questions (e.g. don't re-test intro). For any GENERATED copy (captions, comment replies, variants), read brand_voice.files first and match the SFFS voice + hard rules.
how_the_loop_uses_this.write: After each analytics pull (see ab-testing/README.md 'refresh metrics'): recompute every rollup from ab-database.json posts[] that have metrics.source != 'pending', update front_runners (highest median eng_rate with n_with_metrics >= min_n), append any new conclusion to decisions_log, and bump updated_at. Never delete history; supersede with a new decisions_log entry.

conventions.aggregation: use median, not mean (small sample, outliers like reach<10 noise posts); require min_n before acting

tiktok.note: historical: far outperforms IG on the SAME source video

decisions_log.decision: Dropped the `intro` A/B dimension — every short is cold-open going forward (no intro variants ever).
decisions_log.rationale: WITHINTRO underperformed cold-open NOINTRO: the standout was NOINTRO package 01 (991 reach / 5.55% eng on TikTok), while the WITHINTRO package 03 posts were inconclusive/near-undelivered. Removed `intro` from ab-database.json (schema conventions + every record + the by_intro_standard_only cut) and from the poster tooling.

decisions_log.decision: Started a hashtag A/B test with three rotating sets (A/B/C), recorded per post as hashtag_set.
decisions_log.rationale: Isolate hashtag impact on reach/engagement. A=#fyp #foryou #quiz #trivia #brainteaser; B=#smartorfart #iqtest #puzzletok #riddles #mindgames; C=#quiztime #braintest #canyoupass #puzzle #trivianight. Rotated ~evenly across the 20-post batch (A=7, B=7, C=6 including controls; 14 scheduled arms = A5/B5/C4).

decisions_log.decision: Standardized the caption to 'Are you SMART or FART? Comment your score/answer below and follow for more!!' and set Instagram share-to-Feed ON as the default for future posts.
decisions_log.rationale: Unify hook + add a follow CTA; 'answer' wording only for the no-answer variant (no reveal/score). share-to-Feed default baked into the poster tooling (networks.instagram.details.feed=true); it is only settable at creation, so the current batch's IG posts need a one-time manual toggle.
decisions_log.status: applied (tooling default); current IG batch flagged for manual toggle

decisions_log.decision: Started a TIME A/B — spread the 7 variants across the posting window (evening 18:30/20:30, late-night 23:00, overnight 01:30, overnight-trough 03:30, early-morning 06:30, morning 08:30) instead of clustering them, each variant's IG+TikTok sharing a time.
decisions_log.rationale: Find the best publish time with a research-backed spread that also samples low-traffic overnight slots. Re-timing required recreate+delete (Publer PUT cannot change scheduled_at). no-answer left at 18:30 (too close to go-live to churn). Recorded per post as time_bucket.
